_note: Indicative prices (USD per image) measured on the CogFoundry gateway, used ONLY to print an indicative range on a fresh clone where no price has been observed yet. They are never folded into a quote or a total. An observed price in references/price-observations.json (written by real runs) always wins. A hint is shown only for text-to-image rows with an explicit quality (never for reference calls or 'auto' quality, which bill differently), and is ignored 180 days after the measured date.
